title: 认证安全地图态势
description: 基于认证审计事件的只读 2D 地理态势；地图仅展示地域聚合结果，不展示单个 IP。

list.name: country
list.label: 国家/地区
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') AS __value FROM auth_security_events ORDER BY __text
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') AS __value FROM auth_security_events ORDER BY __text

list.name: region
list.label: 省/地区
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') AS __value FROM auth_security_events WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') = ${country:sqlstring}) ORDER BY __text
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') AS __value FROM auth_security_events WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') = ${country:sqlstring}) ORDER BY __text

panels.title: 全球认证风险态势
panels.description: 点大小表示事件总量，颜色表示失败率；需要认证事件已完成 GeoIP 经纬度解析。

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(created_at) AS time, latitude, longitude, COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') AS country, COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') AS region, COALESCE(NULLIF(city, ''), '未知') AS city, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS failure_rate FROM auth_security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND (${eventType:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR event_type = ${eventType:sqlstring}) AND (${result:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR result = ${result:sqlstring}) AND (${country:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (${region:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') = ${region:sqlstring}) GROUP BY latitude, longitude, country, region, city ORDER BY total_count DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '5m'), CONCAT(event_type, ' / ', result) AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM auth_security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (${eventType:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR event_type = ${eventType:sqlstring}) AND (${result:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR result = ${result:sqlstring}) AND (${country:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (${region:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') = ${region:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, event_type, result ORDER BY 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS failure_rate FROM auth_security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND (${eventType:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR event_type = ${eventType:sqlstring}) AND (${result:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR result = ${result:sqlstring}) AND (${country:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (${region:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') = ${region:sqlstring})

panels.title: 高风险来源 IP
panels.description: 点击 IP 跳转管理端执行人工风控。

targets.rawSql: SELECT ip_address, COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') AS country, COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') AS region, COALESCE(NULLIF(city, ''), '未知') AS city, COUNT(*) AS failed_count, COUNT(DISTINCT account_hash) AS account_count, MAX(created_at) AS last_seen, SUBSTRING(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT failure_reason ORDER BY failure_reason SEPARATOR ', '), 1, 160) AS failure_reasons FROM auth_security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND result = 'FAILED' AND ip_address IS NOT NULL AND (${eventType:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR event_type = ${eventType:sqlstring}) AND (${result:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR result = ${result:sqlstring}) AND (${country:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (${region:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') = ${region:sqlstring}) GROUP BY ip_address, country, region, city ORDER BY failed_count DESC LIMIT 50

value.title: 在管理端进行 IP 风控

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') AS country, COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') AS region, COALESCE(NULLIF(city, ''), '未知') AS city, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS failure_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) AS ip_count FROM auth_security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (${eventType:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR event_type = ${eventType:sqlstring}) AND (${result:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR result = ${result:sqlstring}) AND (${country:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (${region:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') = ${region:sqlstring}) GROUP BY country, region, city ORDER BY failed_count DESC, total_count DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT created_at AS time, event_type, result, user_type, method, account_masked, ip_address, COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') AS country, COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') AS region, COALESCE(NULLIF(city, ''), '未知') AS city, failure_reason, trace_id FROM auth_security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (${eventType:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR event_type = ${eventType:sqlstring}) AND (${result:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR result = ${result:sqlstring}) AND (${country:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') = ${country:sqlstring}) AND (${region:sqlstring} = 'ALL' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(region, ''), '未知') = ${region:sqlstring}) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200
